newsitem.title: USA: Vertex has oral treatment for nerve injury.
newsitem.headline: Vertex has oral treatment for nerve injury.

text.p: Vertex Pharmaceuticals Inc said Monday it has designed an oral treatment that has speeded the recovery of damaged nerves in laboratory rats.
The next step will be to assess the compound's effect on neurodegenerative disorders such as Alzheimer's and Parkinson's diseases, Vertex said.

"The findings reported today are preliminary and it will be years before we will know whether or not these compounds have therapeutic benefit in patients with nerve injury," the company said in a release.

Vertex is trying to design and develop oral drugs for treating diseases such as Alzheimer's and for nerve injuries through its neuroimmunophilins program. The company said it has three patents containing claims related to this program.
